title: Budget Allocation Meeting
summary: Liam Brown and Maria Garcia discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for before the board meeting on Thursday, but Liam Brown's revised estimate is sometime in Q3. The conflict was not resolved.
